query_fasta.description: Absolute path to the query FASTA file containing one or more sequences for MMseqs2 to search against `target_db`.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream sequence-producing tool. Translates to a temporary FASTA when `query_fasta` is omitted.

target_db.description: Path to an MMseqs2 target database directory or single-file index (typically UniRef30/UniRef50 or a custom domain set).

min_seq_id.description: Minimum sequence identity threshold for reporting hits (0.0-1.0). Lower values return more remote homologs.

coverage.description: Minimum coverage fraction (`-c`) the alignment must span on the shorter of query/target.

sensitivity.description: MMseqs2 sensitivity (`-s`). 7.5 is the most sensitive (and slowest); 1.0-4.0 are fast but miss remote hits.

max_seqs.description: Maximum number of hits per query (`--max-seqs`).
